Some of the storylines are surprisingly addictive and do a good job of keeping you watching, but that is about the only positive thing I can say.

The actual quality control is poor. Transitions between scenes are often badly handled, with characters suddenly wearing different clothes, significant injuries disappearing from one scene to the next, and characters’ behaviour or demeanour changing in ways that make no sense. It feels like very little attention is being paid to continuity.

That might be easier to overlook if this were a cheap novelty app, but the pricing makes it almost impossible to justify. At around £22 per week, the subscription cost is frankly absurd for the level of quality being offered. You’re talking about more than £1,100 per year for AI-generated short-form video content with obvious continuity and production issues.

For comparison, you can subscribe to major streaming platforms offering professionally produced films and series in 4K, or buy AAA games with vastly higher production values, for substantially less.

I have watched countless ads to earn coins, and I have also purchased coins on three separate occasions. However, your app is using both my purchased coins and the coins I earned from watching ads without ever asking for my permission. At no point did I authorize the app to automatically spend coins—especially not the ones I worked for by watching ad after ad. The system is supposed to give me the option to continue watching by viewing an ad, but instead it forces me to watch ads to earn coins, then immediately spends those coins without asking. This is deceptive and completely unacceptable.
To be clear: I did not authorize the use of my purchased coins.
I did not authorize the use of the coins I earned by watching ads.
The app is draining coins without giving me any choice, which is misleading and feels like a rip-off.
I hope this issue will be addressed immediately. I am requesting a full review of my account and a restoration of all coins that were used without my explicit consent. If this problem is not resolved quickly, I will have no choice but to report this behavior, as it appears to be abusive and potentially fraudulent.
